meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装上后可处理基因组区间数据:对 BED 文件做重叠检测、生成覆盖度轨道、把区域转成机器学习 token、拆分单细胞片段、按 refget 取参考序列。可输出 Python 或命令行操作。
howto.when: 当任务涉及基因组区间/BED 文件、重叠检测、覆盖度轨道等基因组分析时触发。
howto.what_en: After install, Claude handles genomic interval data: overlap detection between BED regions, coverage track generation, tokenization for ML, fragment splitting, and refget sequence retrieval, outputting Python or CLI commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task involves genomic intervals/BED files, overlap detection, coverage tracks, or similar genomic interval analysis.

say_en.text: Use gtars to compare chip_peaks.bed and promoters.bed for overlaps.
say_en.note: Produces a BED file of overlapping peaks.

say_en.text: Generate a 10bp-resolution WIG coverage track from atac_fragments.bed.
say_en.note: Runs the uniwig module to output a WIG file.

say_en.text: Use TreeTokenizer to tokenize training_regions.bed for ML.
say_en.note: Outputs discrete tokens for genomic ML models.
